程序包 org.bukkit.block

接口 BlockState

所有超级接口:
Metadatable
所有已知子接口:
Banner, Beacon, BrewingStand, Chest, CommandBlock, CreatureSpawner, Dispenser, Dropper, Furnace, Hopper, Jukebox, NoteBlock, Sign, Skull
public interface BlockState extends Metadatable
Represents a captured state of a block, which will not change automatically. 表示一个方块的已捕获状态，它不会自动更改。

Unlike Block, which only one object can exist per coordinate, BlockState can exist multiple times for any given Block. Note that another plugin may change the state of the block and you will not know, or they may change the block to another type entirely, causing your BlockState to become invalid. 与每个坐标只能存在一个对象的 Block 不同，BlockState 可以针对任意给定的 Block 存在多个实例。注意，其他插件可能会在你不知情的情况下更改方块的状态，或者将方块完全更改为另一种类型，从而使你的 BlockState 失效。

    • getLocation

      Location getLocation(Location loc)
      Stores the location of this block in the provided Location object. 将此方块的位置存储到提供的 Location 对象中。

      If the provided Location is null this method does nothing and returns null. 如果提供的 Location 为 null，此方法不执行任何操作并返回 null。

      参数:
      loc - the location to copy into 要复制到的位置
      返回:
      The Location object provided or null 提供的 Location 对象或 null

    • update

      boolean update()
      Attempts to update the block represented by this state, setting it to the new values as defined by this state. 尝试更新此状态所表示的方块，将其设置为此状态所定义的新值。

      This has the same effect as calling update(false). That is to say, this will not modify the state of a block if it is no longer the same type as it was when this state was taken. It will return false in this eventuality. 这与调用 update(false) 效果相同。也就是说，如果方块已不再是从前获取此状态时的类型，则不会修改其状态。在这种情况下将返回 false。

      返回:
      true if the update was successful, otherwise false 若更新成功则为 true，否则为 false
      另请参阅:
      • update(boolean)

    • update

      boolean update(boolean force)
      Attempts to update the block represented by this state, setting it to the new values as defined by this state. 尝试更新此状态所表示的方块，将其设置为此状态所定义的新值。

      This has the same effect as calling update(force, true). That is to say, this will trigger a physics update to surrounding blocks. 这与调用 update(force, true) 效果相同。也就是说，这将触发周围方块的物理更新。

      参数:
      force - true to forcefully set the state 为 true 则强制设置状态
      返回:
      true if the update was successful, otherwise false 若更新成功则为 true，否则为 false

    • update

      boolean update(boolean force, boolean applyPhysics)
      Attempts to update the block represented by this state, setting it to the new values as defined by this state. 尝试更新此状态所表示的方块，将其设置为此状态所定义的新值。

      Unless force is true, this will not modify the state of a block if it is no longer the same type as it was when this state was taken. It will return false in this eventuality. 除非 force 为 true，否则如果方块已不再是从前获取此状态时的类型，则不会修改其状态。在这种情况下将返回 false。

      If force is true, it will set the type of the block to match the new state, set the state data and then return true. 如果 force 为 true，它将把方块的类型设置为新状态，设置状态数据并返回 true。

      If applyPhysics is true, it will trigger a physics update on surrounding blocks which could cause them to update or disappear. 如果 applyPhysics 为 true，将对周围方块触发物理更新，这可能导致它们更新或消失。

      参数:
      force - true to forcefully set the state 为 true 则强制设置状态
      applyPhysics - false to cancel updating physics on surrounding 为 false 则取消周围方块的物理更新 blocks
      返回:
      true if the update was successful, otherwise false 若更新成功则为 true，否则为 false

    • isPlaced

      boolean isPlaced()
      Returns whether this state is placed in the world. 返回此状态是否被放置在世界中。 Some methods will not work if the blockState isn't placed in the world. 如果 blockState 未被放置在世界中，某些方法将无法工作。
      返回:
      whether the state is placed in the world 该状态是被放置在世界中还是“虚拟的”（例如在物品堆上） or 'virtual' (e.g. on an itemstack)
